Toblerone Diamond Truffles with Biscoff® combine smooth Toblerone milk chocolate, rich Biscoff® spread filling, and crunchy honey-almond nougat pieces in a distinctive diamond shape
Available in two formats: a 495g premium box exclusive to Costco across ten markets, and a 180g sharing box in select countries
Marks the first global retail partnership between Mondelēz International and Costco
Collaboration deepens Toblerone's premium positioning and reinforces Mondelēz International's strategy to lead in premium chocolate innovation
